source_native_model.source_code_locator: archived code.R Figure 5 plant reproductive-success block

aggregation_unit: plant x site x season mean pollen_z; multiple flowers from a cell are not treated as independent network exposures
mechanistic_reading: The source Figure-5 line and fixed-effect sensitivities point in the same positive direction across the full, mainland, Izu-island and post-Oshima subsets. Unlike FDQ-to-trait-matching, however, the island-only leave-one-site ranges cross zero. The downstream matching-to-pollen-receipt link is therefore positive but materially less robust.
relation_to_response_heterogeneity: A robust upstream functional-diversity-to-matching association need not translate into a uniform reproductive response across plants or islands. This attenuation is consistent with the independent 2017 sensitivity/resilience/counterdirectional reproductive modes.
claim_boundary: Contemporary observational reproductive-function context only; not a mediation analysis. TM_z is a site-season community metric shared by plants, while pollen receipt varies among plants and flowers. Time-varying environment, plant condition, measurement error and network feedback remain. Do not infer that historical FDQ change caused pollen receipt, breeding-system evolution or floral evolution.
